# W13 native Codex memory-root candidate

This directory pins the source and attribution for an explicitly selected native extension. It does not change Cockpit's runtime selection or install a CLI. David delegated the extension scope choice; the execution owner selected a separate candidate. Upstream release tag/source commit, original license/notice hashes, baseline executable hash and an embedded matching source-commit observation are recorded in upstream.json. A matching embedded identifier is provenance evidence, not a reproducible-build or package-acceptance claim.

The pristine reference is third-party/codex-upstream-w13-0.162.1 under the shared repos root. The declared candidate worktree is tools/codex-w13-memory-root on codex/w13-memory-root. Upstream's push URL is disabled. No fork has been published; completed patch bytes are checkpointed here on the authorized Cockpit branch. Original Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE are retained verbatim.

The candidate adds proposed memories.root as an explicitly absolute **base directory**, retaining the versioned memories/ and memories_v2/ layout beneath it. The native account HOME/CODEX_HOME/auth locator stays unchanged. No override preserves upstream defaults. Versioned nesting keeps dual-write and reset separate; memory job databases still need the existing per-binding sqlite_home selection. Namespace selection is not a same-user filesystem sandbox. No isolated native-memory acceptance is claimed before actual read/write/continuity and negative-root proof.

Rust1.95.0 was added for this build with explicit human approval; the existing default stable toolchain remains unchanged. 369 configuration tests and6 focused consumer tests pass;2 affected extension tests pass again after warning cleanup. The patch applies cleanly to the pristine pinned source. The CLI candidate build and end-to-end native proof remain open. Native memory generation stays off in controlled probes; no native background worker/helper exception is inferred. Installation, replacement, publication and release qualification remain separate gates.

The complete adapted diff is patches/0001-isolated-native-memory-root.patch. It includes upstream-local Cargo.lock version normalization (161 local packages only); all external lock records remain unchanged. Apply it to the pinned upstream commit, retain the original license/notice, and use the pinned Rust1.95.0 compiler. The candidate commit and patch hash are recorded in upstream.json.

Patch format uses zero context to avoid treating the required blank unified-diff context prefix as trailing whitespace in the containing Git repository. Verify HEAD equals the pinned upstream commit, then use `git apply --check --index --unidiff-zero PATCH` followed by `git apply --index --unidiff-zero PATCH`. Both source identity and original index blobs must match.
